title: Make CLI package executable after install
description: Review finding from loreweaver-den. packages/cli declares a bin target, but src/index.ts has no shebang; installed loreweaver may fail on POSIX shells unless packaging injects one. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Built dist/index.js starts with a valid shebang; package smoke test can run the loreweaver bin after npm pack or equivalent install; Windows execution remains covered.
notes: Fix: #!/usr/bin/env node shebang in packages/cli/src/index.ts; tsc preserves it into dist/index.js. RED: new test 'built dist/index.js starts with a node shebang' failed pre-fix. GREEN: 205 pass.
